brief:
Israeli settlers have violently taken over and occupied Palestinian homes in Jericho, in the occupied West Bank, according to Drop Site News. The takeover represents an escalation in Israel's dispossession of Palestinians across the territory.

Settler actions in occupied Palestinian areas have repeatedly targeted homes and land, creating recurring conflict between Israeli settlers and Palestinian residents in the West Bank.
dek: The takeover by Israeli settlers of homes inside a Palestinian city in the occupied West Bank represents a dangerous escalation in Israel’s dispossession of Palestinians across the territory.
title: Israeli settlers seize Palestinian homes in Jericho
